resources.string: With your permission, Sakshi reads available notification previews from apps you choose. Android notification access covers all notifications, but Sakshi filters your selected apps before reading message text. Previews stay on this device in memory until you explicitly save them to a case. Unsaved previews clear when the vault locks unless you separately choose observation while switching apps. Turning this off or revoking access always clears them. This does not read chat history, outgoing messages, hidden content, or View Once media.

Separate optional consent: continue observing selected apps while you switch apps and the vault locks. Unsaved drafts are bounded and kept only in memory, never written to disk. They clear when the screen turns off, the device locks, the process ends, observation is turned off, or access is revoked. Android and source apps may still omit previews; capture is not guaranteed.

Optional alerts use an unreviewed demonstration phrase list, not a threat prediction. Phrase matches can misinterpret quotes, negation, or context. Alerts ask you to review a preview and show no message text, sender, or category. Android notification permission is requested only when you enable this.
